meta.seo_title: aBeam — On-Demand Boat Concierge, San Francisco
meta.seo_description: Text aBeam the morning you want to go out. Your boat is fueled, provisioned, checked and ready at your San Francisco slip. Flat fee per outing.
meta.tagline: By your side, Beyond the shore

hero.headline: Text us this morning. Sail this afternoon.
hero.subhead: One text, the morning of. When you reach the dock, your boat is fueled, provisioned, checked and ready, with a conditions brief already on your phone.
hero.micro: Same-morning texts welcome. Launching at South Beach, Pier 39 and Marina Green.

showcase.headline: One text covers the whole boat.
showcase.intro: Orbit the boat and open a zone. Hull, deck, cabin, engine room: each has a service behind it, and the same small local team handles all of them.
showcase.hint: Drag to orbit · Tap a marker or a chip

hotspots.label: Whole boat
hotspots.title: The whole boat, off your calendar.
hotspots.tooltip: The calendar, the vendors, the upkeep. We'll keep it all in hand.
hotspots.body: Haul-out dates, bottom paint, the canvas shop, the rigger, the slip paperwork. We keep the calendar, coordinate the vendors and log every visit. The boat stays ready; you stay informed, without chasing anyone.

hotspots.label: Hull & exterior
hotspots.title: Washed, polished, and the brightwork seen to.
hotspots.tooltip: Salt haze on the gelcoat again. Leave it with us.
hotspots.body: A season of westerlies leaves salt in every seam and a grey film on the gelcoat. We wash and wax the topsides, bring the brightwork back and detail the interior down to the lockers. On its own, or with your next Ready & Go.

hotspots.label: Deck
hotspots.title: Lines flaked, fenders set, deck wiped.
hotspots.tooltip: Deck wiped, lines flaked, trash ashore. Nothing for you to step over.
hotspots.body: Before every outing we set fenders and dock lines for your slip, wipe the deck and cockpit, take the trash off and run through the safety gear: life jackets, flares, extinguisher, propane. Then we text you it's ready and step off the dock.

hotspots.label: Cabin
hotspots.title: Ice in, water topped, galley stocked.
hotspots.tooltip: Ice in the box, drinks cold, groceries stowed. Nothing to carry down.
hotspots.body: Text us a list the morning of and it's aboard before you are: ice in the cooler, drinks cold, groceries stowed, fresh water topped off, cabin aired and wiped down.

hotspots.label: Engine room
hotspots.title: We look first. We fix if asked.
hotspots.tooltip: Oil's a shade dark. Noted. Say the word and we'll see to it.
hotspots.body: During Ready & Go we check oil level and color, battery reading and bilge. If anything looks off we tell you at once and stop there. Repairs happen only when you ask: our own repair team, or a trusted local marine mechanic we know.

how.headline: Three steps. One text starts it.
how.intro: Built for the morning-of decision: the fog forecast looks kind, you have the afternoon, and you'd rather not spend an hour prepping. Decide late, still go.

steps.title: Text us the morning of
steps.body: Boat name, marina, slip, when you'd like to be off the dock, anything you want aboard. A text is fastest; the short form below works too.

steps.title: We confirm a ready-by time
steps.body: One reply, with the time your boat will be ready. Then we go to work, and you go back to yours.

steps.title: Show up and go
steps.body: Your conditions brief lands before you do. Fuel and water topped, ice in, engine checked, fenders set. Lines are ready to slip. Step aboard.

included.headline: The hour at the dock, itemized.
included.intro: Every Ready & Go covers the same six jobs, in the same order, logged the same way. One flat fee, no menu to build.

items.title: Systems check
items.line: Oil level and color, battery reading, bilge. Noted, not guessed.

items.title: Fuel & water
items.line: Fuel topped off, fresh water filled. Tanks full when you step aboard.

items.title: Provisioning
items.line: Ice, drinks and whatever groceries you texted, loaded and stowed.

items.title: Propane & safety
items.line: Propane level, life jackets, flares, extinguisher: checked, expiry dates read.

items.title: Deck prep
items.line: Fenders and lines set for your slip, quick wipe-down, trash off.

items.title: Conditions brief
items.line: Wind, tide and weather for your route, texted before you arrive.

included.footnote: During Ready & Go we check and alert; we don't repair. If a fluid looks off or a flare's expired, you hear first, then choose: a trusted local mechanic or our repair team.

brief_sample.message: For your 1pm: fog lifting off Alcatraz, sun by noon. Westerly 12 kts now, 20+ in the Slot by 3. Max ebb 2:40 at the Gate, so expect chop past Crissy. Halcyon ready by 12:30.
brief_sample.caption: The brief that lands before you've left the office.

services.headline: When the boat needs more than prep.
services.intro: Ready & Go is the front door. Behind it is the same small team for the jobs that don't fit into a morning.

cards.title: Detailing
cards.body: Exterior wash and wax, brightwork, interior detailing down to the lockers. Salt, sun and pelicans are hard on a boat. We undo it, on a schedule or on request.

cards.title: Repairs & Maintenance
cards.body: Oil changes, impellers, batteries, winch service, the leak you keep meaning to chase. Our own repair team handles it, or we connect you with a trusted local marine mechanic.

cards.title: Full Management
cards.body: Upkeep, scheduling, storage and vendor coordination for owners who'd rather read one update than field a dozen calls. One point of contact, every visit logged.

services.more: A diver booked, a part collected, a surveyor met. Text us and ask. If it's not something we do, we'll tell you who does.

marinas.headline: Built for boats at three city marinas.
marinas.intro: South Beach Harbor beside the ballpark, Pier 39 in the thick of the Wharf, and the San Francisco Marina off Marina Green, nearest the Gate. Tap a pin for status and berths.
marinas.footnote: A marina shows as serving only once we've confirmed dock access there. Not listed, or still coming soon? Text us and we'll tell you where things stand.

trust.headline: Who was aboard, and what was done.
trust.intro: Handing over the companionway key to someone you haven't met takes trust. We've arranged things so you never have to take our word for it.

points.title: Fully insured for boat access
points.body: We're fully insured for boat access. Marinas require it, and so should you. Ask us for the insurance certificate any time. We work within your marina's vendor rules, not around them.

points.title: Every visit logged
points.body: Who was aboard, when, and what was done, written down every time. A fluid looked off, a flare expired, a fender moved: it's in the record and in your text.

points.title: Small, local, vetted team
points.body: Not a franchise, not a rotating roster of contractors. A few people we've vetted ourselves, who know these docks and know each other. You'll know their names.

points.title: We check. We don't tinker.
points.body: During Ready & Go we look and report; we never start a repair you haven't asked for. If something's off, you choose: our repair team, or a trusted local marine mechanic we'll introduce.

pricing.headline: One fee per outing, agreed up front.
pricing.price_note: A flat fee per Ready & Go, set by your boat's length, typically $75–150. Fuel, ice and provisions are added at cost. No hourly clock.
pricing.includes_line: Every outing includes all six Ready & Go items, the conditions brief and a logged record of the visit.
pricing.membership_body: For owners who go out often. We're working out the terms now. Leave your number and you'll hear when it's ready, and not before.

book.headline: Tell us when you want to go.
book.intro: Texting is fastest. If you'd rather use the form, it reaches the same people. Either way, you get a ready-by time back.

placeholders.name: First and last name
placeholders.phone: Best number for the ready-by text
placeholders.notes: Ice, sparkling water, sandwiches for four. Thinking Angel Island and back.

book.alt_line: Or skip the form and just text us.
book.success: Got it. We'll text you back with a ready-by time. If anything needs a decision, we'll ask before we act. Finish your coffee. The dock is handled.
book.composing: Opening your messages with the details filled in. Just hit send.
book.error_required: We'll need this to get started.
book.privacy: Your details go to us and no one else. We text about your booking, not marketing.

sms_templates.auto_reply: aBeam here. Thanks, we have your message and will text back with a ready-by time. If you haven't yet, send your boat name, marina, slip and when you'd like to leave.
sms_templates.confirm_ready_by: aBeam here. [Boat name] at [marina], slip [slip], will be ready by [time]. Fuel, water, ice and [provisions] are on the list. Your conditions brief follows before you head down. Anything to add, just reply.
sms_templates.ready: [Boat name] is ready at [slip]. Fuel and water full, ice in, lines and fenders set, systems checked and logged. Your brief is above. Step aboard whenever you like.
sms_templates.flag_issue: aBeam here. Checking [boat name], we found [issue]. Noted in your log, not touched; we don't repair during Ready & Go. [Everything else is ready.] Two options: a trusted local marine mechanic we can connect you with, or our own repair team. Just reply.
sms_templates.conditions_brief: Brief for your [time]: [fog/sun] now, [clearing by noon]. Westerly [xx] kts, building to [xx] in the Slot by [time]. [Ebb/flood] at the Gate, max [time], so expect [chop/smooth water] off [Crissy/Alcatraz]. [Out on the ebb, home on the flood.] [Boat name] ready by [time].

email_confirmation.body:
Hi [name],

Your Ready & Go is booked.

Boat: [boat name], slip [slip], [marina]
Ready by: [time] on [date]
Provisions: [list]

Before you arrive we'll text a conditions brief with wind, tide and weather for your route. During the visit we check and alert; if anything looks off, you'll hear from us before anything is done about it. We don't repair during prep unless you ask.

Flat fee: $[amount], with fuel, ice and provisions added at cost. A record of who was aboard and what was done follows the visit.

Change of plans? Reply here or text us.

aBeam

faq.q: How far ahead do I need to text?
faq.a: The morning you want to go out is fine; that's what Ready & Go is built for. Earlier is welcome, especially for a busy Saturday or a long provisions list, and we'll confirm a ready-by time either way.

A flat fee per outing, set by your boat's length, typically $75–150. Fuel, ice and provisions are added at cost, and that's the whole bill. You'll know the fee before we step aboard. Membership pricing is coming; join the waitlist to hear first.

faq.q: What if you find something wrong?
faq.a: We tell you straight away and stop there. During Ready & Go we check and alert; we don't repair. From there it's your choice: we can connect you with a trusted local marine mechanic, or our own repair team can handle it.

faq.q: Do you have access to my marina yet?
faq.a: We're launching at South Beach Harbor, Pier 39 Marina and the San Francisco Marina at Marina Green. A marina shows as serving on our chart only once dock access there is confirmed, never before. Text us your marina and slip and we'll tell you where things stand.
